description: Ministry of Labour - The Wages Boards Ordinance Hon. Minister of Labour appoint 17 Persons to be members of the wages Board for the Paddy Hulling Trade for a period of three years Commencing of 01st April, 2015
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the appointment of members to a Wages Board for the Paddy Hulling Trade. This falls under public sector administration related to labor regulations and service conditions, which is classified as a Public Service Gazette (Type 8). While it involves appointments, these are not high-level government personnel changes (like ministers or department heads) but rather administrative appointments to a regulatory board, making it distinct from the government-related classifications (Types 1-3).
